product_metadata.title: EdenHomes Chenille Bathroom Rug Mat, 30"x20" (Set of 2), Extra Soft, Non-Slip, Absorbent Shaggy Rug, Machine Washable, Quick Dry Bathmat, Luxurious Plush Carpet for Bath Room Floor (Black)
features: ✨ SERIOUSLY SOFT - Your toes will be dry and snuggly when you step out of the shower onto a shaggy chenille cloud. The whole family will enjoy the soft texture on bare feet. Our plush bathmats are made out of soft yet durable chenille to bring comfort to the floors of your master bath, guest bathroom, kitchen, or dorm room.

✨ ABSORBENT - Our shaggy chenille bathroom rugs will keep your toes dry with our thick fibers (1600 gsm) for maximum absorption compared to other bathmats (1250 gsm). Chunky shag absorbs water quickly to make bathrooms big or small feel like an oasis. Perfect for coastal cottages, bohemian bungalows, or anything in between.

✨ NON SLIP - Tired of slipping and sliding on bath rugs that won't stay in place? Our durable TPR rubber backing keeps your shower mat in place, wash after wash and won't disintigrate like PVC. Place the bathmat on a dry smooth surface and let the skid resistant backing protect your kids or elders from unwanted falls.

✨ EASY TO CLEAN - Life’s messes don’t have to be your cleanup stresses, our chenille shaggy floor mat can handle daily use from muddy dog paws to splashing kids. Let your washing machine do the work, simply toss the bath rug into the wash and tumble dry on low. We’ve made it easy to restore your bathmat to its former, less dirty glory.

✨ EDENPRODUCTS BENEFITS - EdenProducts is a family business devoted to high quality and innovative products. Our top priorities as a business are product quality and customer satisfaction. We will do what it takes to meet these priorities and to meet our customers' expectations. Contact our support specialists if you have any questions or concerns.
